Ever since Kang Seol was a child, he's had strange dreams where he and several people wear masks while playing "World of Eternity," a board game full of quests and adventures. And although Seol was great at the game, he was never able to win. But now, his dreams have become reality, and humans have become game pieces. Humanity's only hope is for Seol to recall what he did in his dreams to survive. Even though he's never won, will he be able to turn the tables and finally make his way to victory?

(Source: Tapas)

167111.description:
A hellish cohabitation life that begins after death. "I wanted to see you again. Even if I went to hell."

Saginomiya Raku, a con artist who died in an accident, unexpectedly reunites with his high school classmate, Gotokuji Manabu, in hell. Manabu was once a bullied kid, and worked hard because he admired Raku. However, for Raku, Manabu was the person who caused his life to spiral downwards. And now, even after death, Manabu has been waiting for Raku in hell, saying he desperately wanted to see him again. As punishment for his misdeeds in life, Raku is forced to live together with Manabu in a hellish apartment. Raku wants to escape this life of punishment as soon as possible, but Manabu, who is happy to see him again, seems to be enjoying himself and declares that he will not let him think of this as punishment.

167137.description:
When Stella was young, her family and her home were stolen from her.

As she fled with her servants, she was rescued by none other than Count Shvef -- the man who was responsible for her plight in the first place. And so she came to live in the home of her father's bitter rival, all the while, secretly planning her revenge... Until the count's eldest son, Michel, took a liking to her.

He wasn't a particularly capable man, and was rather spoiled, so Stella became his caretaker. Eventually, even the count became like family to her. With Michel's social debut looming, our heroine decided to leave the mansion. But on the night of Michel's debutante ball, he summoned her... and his entire demeanor changed.

She suddenly found herself waking up, wearing an unfamiliar dress in an unfamiliar mansion. Michel knew she was planning to leave him. And he knew he couldn't let that happen. No matter what, he's going to make Stella his bride...

167577.description: Ami Nonomiya is the daughter of a famous pianist who once aspired to become one herself. However, due to a mysterious illness that also took the life of her mother, Ami went blind and deaf. Her father is determined to bring her back to how she was... no matter what it costs him.

167578.description:
Kwon Seong-chan, an ordinary high school senior who wants to become a profiler. After graduating from high school, he announced that he would not go to college, causing a great conflict with his parents. One rainy night while leaving school late and staying cool with his family, an incident occurs in Sung-chan's house where his family is murdered, and Sung-chan holds a weapon in his hand. Seong-chan, who is caught right away at the scene, clears himself of false charges and traces the traces of his family to uncover the truth behind his murder....

(Source: Naver; translated)

167579.description:
Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That’s what wallflower Ja-Yu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Ja-Hyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost. Underneath Ja-Hyeok’s persona is a secret super-introvert who would rather just stay home, except his charming good looks keep forcing him into social situations. Together, Ja-Yu and Ja-Hyeok begin to learn a little something about friendship and maybe more…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: 内気な男女は恋がしたい

167580.description:
Top Idol and school bully switched bodies?!

Hong Joo-Ah, a school bully who is bullied every day at school. Yo-Han, a top idol loved by the entire nation. Joo-Ah envies the life of a beloved idol, while Yo-Han envies the life of a normal, free person. One day, their bodies are switched!

A spectacular body-swapping romance, Sasangdol!

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

167581.description:
No luck in love, no luck in money, no luck in family, no answer, Hong Sia. One winter day, I picked up a cat, or rather a Jangsanbeom?! Eh?! I imprinted on Jang Sanbeom, a monster with transcendental abilities?!! “I decide who my contractors will sell to.” A life-changing romance thriller with a beast man, no, a real beast!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: เทพเสือจางซาน

167582.description:
Stepping in a puddle, slipping and falling, getting pooped on by a bird—Hwi-Bum seems to attract misfortune like a magnet. Universally acknowledged as the unluckiest guy on Earth, he finds himself partnered with Yeon-Woo, a student with the gloomiest aura he's ever seen, for a group project. Initially attributing it to his typical luck, Hwi-Bum is surprised when Yeon-Woo not only takes on the project single-handedly but also brings an unexpected twist to Hwi-Bum's fortune. As Hwi-Bum starts to revel in his newfound luck, he dismisses the subtle signs of Yeon-Woo's seemingly growing obsession. Is Hwi-Bum truly starting to turn his luck around with this relationship, or is there more to Yeon-Woo's fixation than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

167586.description:
The good girl Zhu Yun meets the bad boy Li Xun at their college freshman orientation. Their lives come together and their fates become entangled, as our story begins…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 電マ一本で異世界ハーレム

167588.description:
This is a world where magic and science both exist. In this world, some people want powerful magic; some people pursue eternal truth. Blair, the protagonist, is a math teacher from a different world. Using both magic and science, he will soon achieve success in a way that no one has thought of before!

A great scholar? The supreme mage? A lady-killer?
I guess a few more titles won't hurt.

(Source: Webnovel)

167590.description:
After twelve years devoted to baseball and a failed confession to his first love, Kim Min-Seong drifts through life with nothing left to chase. Hoping for a fresh start, he sets out on a cross-country bike trip, only to be stopped by monsoon rain and an accident. Stranded, he reunites with Park Hyeon-Min, his former junior from the high school baseball team, and ends up staying at his place until the weather clears. Full of awkward proximity, lingering heat, and emotions that won’t stay buried. Even when summer ends, some feelings refuse to let go.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

167592.description:
1. Amaranth no Joou (アマランスの女王)
Orphaned Maara lives at the mercy of others. To earn her expensive tuition she must live in her school's attic and be treated like a slave by the other students. One day she finds a beautiful diamond necklace in the ocean. This necklace gives her newfound confidence... and grand ambitions
2. Tadaima Uranai Nyuumonchuu (ただいま占い入門中)
3. Kuroneko no Tango (黒ネコのタンゴ)

167593.description:
“Actually, I like your unreliable side.”

Subaru, in line to be the next captain of the archery club, always finds herself at a loss when dealing with the junior boy Mikumo, the club’s problem child. Subaru is a serious person who always tries to meet the expectations of other people, but she tends to push herself too hard as a result. Those are the times when she is saved by Mikumo’s easygoing nature and chill vibes. This is the start of a sweet love story where the serious girl becomes smitten by the laid-back boy.

(Source: Dessert, translated)

167598.description:
The story takes place a long time ago... A young man called the God Slayer loses his fight against the last god. When he wakes up, he realizes his body has been changed into a woman’s. Forced to serve the god as his shrine maiden, the man tries to kill the god in his sleep, but again, fails to slay him. The god decides to punish his new shrine maiden for her deeds by bedding her every time she makes an attempt on his life. Having no power to fight the god, the shrine maiden keeps getting punished...

(Source: Fakku!)

167599.description:
A JK with a sex addiction is gently (?) rehabilitated a domineering teacher!? Misao is a high school girl who lives alone. She seems normal at first glance, but she can't stop herself from seeking out sex with strangers. Until one day, when the person who picks her up... is her homeroom teacher from school!? Misao is scared at first, but her teacher makes an outrageous proposal to her...!? A new kind of dark but heart-warming romantic comedy between two people with shady fetishes.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

167603.description:
The nine starry rivers in the sky are filled with billions of stars. The cultivators can commune with the constellations, awaken their spirits, and gain their power. According to legend, the most powerful cultivators can open a star gate with each level's breakthrough, until they ascend to the stars gain immorality at the ninth level. The young man Qin Wentian had to reform his body and start his cultivation from nothing. But he will rise to the heavens and become the brightest star in the sky!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

167605.description:
Towa, has had a one-sided crush for Shuhei for seven years. On the last day of junior high, on her way to confess her love, she suddenly collapses. When she wakes up in a hospital bed, 10 years have passed... She had slept without aging due to the hibernation treatment for her intractable disease... Surprised by the world 10 years later, she starts her high school life with high expectations. And then she is fatefully reunited with Shuhei, who is now a fully grown man, in a place she never expected.

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

This is a story about a quiet girl with a lewd streak who gets molested while waiting in line at her first comic convention.

It's not like I don’t belong here… One year ago, a young boy named Mikane moved back to a small island in Kyushu. The locals are warm, his father is brusque yet kind, and he has a good friend who worries for him. Despite having so much, Mikane feels dissatisfied and lonely. Then, one day, he saves a mysterious, beautiful woman from the sea. His meeting with this “onee-san” will drastically change his destiny!!

167611.description:
Exiled from high society by false accusations, the duchess Minerva is heartbroken after two broken engagements, and had given up hope for marriage. One day, while being publicly scorned and humiliated at a tea party, she meets Rufus, the second prince of the Empire, who is widely feared as "The Dark Prince." Rufus admired how Minerva acted resolutely without losing her composure, and proposed to her right there......?

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)

29-year-old Sumire is chasing her dream by moving from the sales department to hair and makeup. However, she got into a big pinch and is in danger of losing her job!! Until a genius makeup artist Ryusei came to her rescue. Now she is in an exclusive XX relationship with the younger man!?

167617.description: Shirafuji is a girl who has been isolated and mistreated because of her different appearance. She loses the only family she has left and is at a loss. The villagers heartlessly decide to sacrifice her to the gods. She ends her life wishing to live a "normal" life in the next life, but when she wakes up, she finds herself in a world where ayakashi live. Suddenly, she is confronted by a cold-hearted, beautiful young man who calls himself Kogetsu. Shirafuji, who has nowhere else to go, ends up working at the Kokushi inn where he works. A sad but happy love story that begins in the world of ayakashi

The story takes place in the library of a research institute. This book chronicles the fun (and slightly strange) days of Kihara-san, a girl with a bob haircut and glasses who works there, along with her boss and coworkers.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

His bleached hair seemed to shine like a beacon in the midst of her dull, gray life—. A collection of short stories depicting encounters with shady "back alley boys," such as delinquents, emotionally damaged men, and men who work in the nightlife district.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

かりずまいメイストーム

167620.description:
A story about a vicious fox who struggles to protect her favorite young warrior.

The youkai Tamamo, who had a grudge against humans, met the naive samurai Naozumi.

She decides to watch over Naosumi by his side. However, Naosumi, who worries about Tamamo's health, puts her at a distance...?

167621.description:
Rinka's father, who ran a male-host club, has passed away, and Ayatora, the top host at the club and Rinka's first love, suddenly proposes marriage to her. Rinka's newlywed life with Ayatora, who is now the owner of the club, includes a secret arrangement, and Rinka is determined to divorce Ayatora if he dares to try anything with her...? This is a love story between a legendary male host and an innocent college girl, and their married life together!

(Source: Betsucomi, translated)

167622.description:
Rinka is the daughter of a male-host club owner. She loves her parents and everyone at the club, but she is hurt that other people look down on her because she hangs out at the club. Then one day she meets Aya, a young man who will eventually become a legend in Kabukicho. Rinka finds herself opening up to him, but...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 虎と花～虎王の花嫁さんスピンオフ～
title.romaji: Tora to Hana: Tora-ou no Hanayome-san Spinoff

167623.description:
A press statement from Blade and Comrades Publishing: Our imprint’s pride and joy, that masterpiece you all know and love, the Dragon Encyclopedia, is celebrating its 50th anniversary. Thanks to the highly credible and definitely well-researched contents of our bestseller Dragon Encyclopedia, all adventurers know that “dragon” means three things—gold, glory, and mystery! To celebrate the golden jubilee of this seminal work, B&C Publishing has assigned a special team, consisting of one editor and one adventurer, the task of preparing a second edition. We all know how accurate and comprehensive the first edition was, so we here at B&C are sure it will be light work!

(Source: Yen Press)

167624.description:
Two months after launching the video channel "Urban Legend Cruise," the channel's owner Tojo Riam, meets Professor Akiyuki Kagami, an urban legend researcher who was about to retire, and decides to recruit him to pursue new urban legends! This is a comedy about urban legends and other bizarre occurrences, set in Minatomirai, Yokohama!

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

167625.description:
On a summer day, as the cicadas chirped loudly. Haruka Nanami, a second-year high school girl, receives a confession of love from Kudo Satoru, a boy from another high school. Haruka is confused, telling him, "I've never even talked to you before..." Kudo suggests that they start out as friends, and the two exchange contacts. At the same time, at a nearby railroad crossing in town, a series of accidents occur. They are madly in love. They want to be together, but they can't. A midsummer love/horror story that you will never forget.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

167626.description: 20th century Shanghai, China. In a society that has outlawed jiangshi, mafia groups have opened businesses exploiting corpses. Lei had his family snatched away from him, and even his own body was made into a jiangshi's. It was then that he met Mei Lan, a beautiful taoist who cracks down on jiangshi related crimes. With his eccentric partner, he intends to make every effort to liberate all jiangshi from their curse and bury the dark taoist, Hei Xu.

167627.description:
A heartwarming (?) romantic comedy with a sweet but poisonous tongue...

The handsome knight is given the task of enticing the reclusive princess out of her room. But behind his princely smile is another face!?

(Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

やんちゃな彼とハジメテのこと

167630.description:
Saya is a high school girl who lost her parents when she was young. She lives alone with support from her relatives.

She loves to eat, and her goal is to open her own restaurant in the future, She has her share of hardships, but she still manages to put a smile on her face every day.

But there is one change in Saya's daily life. She began to see strange creatures. However, since there was no harm in particular, she left it as it was.

One night, she encountered "it" and it turned hostile towards her.

Just when Saya was ready to die, a tall, slender man with slanted eyes appeared in front of her...

167631.description:
Mami has tried marriage once and failed, so now she's looking for something else. Even if her peers won't get it, she wants what she wants: not marriage, not romance, just a man to spend time with when she needs some company!

Sure enough, when she brings this up at her junior high class reunion, her friends all gang up against her. However, a handsome former classmate she'd almost never spoken to before—Nakamura—does empathize with her! When Mami learns that Nakamura is also once-divorced and, just like her, is looking not for a wife or a girlfriend but just a woman to spend time with, she makes a life-changing decision.

She's given up on living her life according to what's "normal." After spending thirty-some years toiling under the crushing weight of societal expectations, one woman finds herself a partner in crime and a new lease on life in this modern-day survival story.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!
